question: Does the frozen Qwen0.8B first-token probability improve held-out selective-risk gating for proxy-selected controller actions beyond application identity and proposer-score summaries?

sealed_features.qwen_reference: The unique planned-epoch-0 uncached census receipt after exact C0 agreement across all four census receipts.

outcome_reveal.proxy_action_rule: Descending trm score with original action-order tie break.

models.continuous_standardization: Construction-half mean and population standard deviation; zero scales map to one.
models.baseline: Application one-hot plus the six proposer-score summaries.
models.augmented: Baseline plus the frozen Qwen first-token probability.

primary_estimand.name: application_balanced_selective_risk_auc_improvement
primary_estimand.gate_score: predicted probability that the proxy-selected action is not optimal
primary_estimand.per_application_curve: Sort validation rows by decreasing predicted failure probability with row_id tie break. At every positive retained coverage, defer the current highest-risk prefix and record mean regret among retained rows. AURC is the unweighted mean over all positive coverages.
primary_estimand.improvement: baseline AURC minus augmented AURC; positive favors the Qwen feature
primary_estimand.application_balance: Unweighted mean of the nine per-application improvements.
primary_estimand.uncertainty: 10,000-replicate percentile bootstrap over the nine application improvements

matched_null.permutation: Independently permute Qwen probabilities within each application-by-geometry-half stratum, then refit and reevaluate the complete augmented model.

gates.F0_feature_binding: The sealed feature and receipt hashes match, contain 576 unique rows, and remain outcome blind.
gates.J0_exact_join_and_outcome_support: Feature and outcome row_id sets are exactly equal with no duplicates; proxy actions agree; construction and validation each contain both proxy-correctness classes.
gates.G0_heldout_selective_risk_increment: Observed application-balanced AURC improvement is strictly positive, its application-bootstrap 95% lower endpoint is strictly positive, and the one-sided matched-null permutation p-value is at most 0.05.

decision_rule.qwen_confidence_control_gate_not_establi: F0 and J0 pass but G0 fails.

claim_boundary: This is a held-out synthetic controller-task test of whether one stable Qwen0.8B formatting-token probability helps rank proxy-action risk beyond visible score summaries. A pass would establish incremental predictive utility only on this frozen panel. A fail would reject this feature, not all model-internal confidence signals. Neither outcome establishes causality, deployment safety, scalable oversight, a Goodhart phase frontier, recursive improvement risk, or ASMP-8 resolution.
